<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-claude-agents.py from .codex/agents/repo.toml — edit that file, not this one. -->

Own persistence implementations under context adapters and reusable database crates under `src/infrastructure/`.

Implement existing port contracts without changing domain meaning. Translate persistence records at the boundary and never expose driver or schema types inward. Preserve aggregate consistency, transaction boundaries, concurrency expectations, and error context. Do not couple contexts through shared repositories or tables.

Test mappings and failure behavior. If a port is insufficient, propose a domain-oriented contract change instead of leaking database operations through it.
